ྈthugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa las:phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod phreng zhes bya ba rat+na gling pa'i khyad chos bzhugs so:

tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa las: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod phreng zhes bya ba rat+na gling pa'i khyad chos bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rgya gar skad du: gu ru u pa bha he bhi ta ghu ya pu tsa dza sa mā li nā ma: bod skad du: bla ma'i sgrub pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod phreng zhes bya ba: rtsa ba gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo:

sgrub pa mchog la nye bar brtson pa dang: bdag gzhan don gnyis rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod phreng bstan par bya: 'di la rim pa bcu gsum dag gis bstan: bka' bsgo mtshams gcad mchod gtor byin gyis brlab: lha bskyed spyan drangs bzhugs su gsol ba dang: phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka 'bul: bstod bshags smon lam gdab cing bkra shis brjod: de yi las rim dang po 'di nyid de: bdag nyid yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin gyis: bgegs gtor byin gyis brlabs la bka' bsgo ba ni:

hūm̐: thams cad ye nas chos sku'i dkyil 'khor du: gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i bgegs tshogs mi dmigs kyang: byang chub bsgrub la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: bdud dang log 'dren thams cad phyir dengs shig: ā+om̐ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐: ghṛh+ṇā ghṛh+ṇā hūm̐: ghṛh+ṇā pa ya ghṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga wān: bid+yā rā dzā ya hūm̐ phaṭa:
mtshams gcod bya ba ni:

hūm̐: bdag ni dbang chen khros pa'i he ru ka: steng 'og phyogs mtshams mtshon cha'i me ri 'bar: khro chung yak+sha mang po skar ltar 'khrugs: bka' 'das rdul phran bzhin du brlag par 'gyur: ā+om̐ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta ha ya grī wa u tsa ta ya badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa:
mchod gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni:

hūm̐: snod bcud thams cad phyi nang mchod pa'i sprin: snang srid gzhir bzhengs mnyam rdzogs chen po'i klong: phyi nang gsang gsum dpag med ji snyed rnams: dus gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i sprin du gsal: ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta bha la bha ti gu h+ya hrī shwa sa ma ye hūm̐: ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ phaṭa: ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai wid+ya shab+da sarba pū tsa ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐:
gzhal yas lha bskyed pa ni:

hūm̐: pho brang gzhal yas sgo gru rta babs bzhi: chos 'khor gdugs tog pad rdor me ris bskor: ma 'dres pad+ma nyi zla bam gyi gdan: phyi nang dag pa ye shes 'od lnga'i dkyil: ྈ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang: phyogs bcu'i byang sems rgyal ba sras bcas rnams: ma 'dres rang gsal gtso dang 'khor du bcas: sgyu ma chu zla me long bzhin du bskyed: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bhi shud+dhe: pad+ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra ti ra baṃ: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sa ma ya dza:
spyan 'dren pa ni:

hūm̐: chos dbyings rnam dag gsal mdangs dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsum bka' rgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol: rang bzhin sku dang zhing khams gzhal yas nas: yi dam lha tshogs ma lus gshegs su gsol: snang stong thig le bde chen gzhal yas nas: dbang chen yab yum gtso 'khor gshegs su gsol: bde chen 'khor lo lnga yi gzhal yas nas: rigs kyi dhā ki yab yum gshegs su gsol: bka' dang dam tshig gsang ba'i gzhal yas nas: bka' srung dam can thams cad gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza:
bzhugs su gsol ba ni:

hūm̐: dam tshig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir: sgyu ma chu zla mkha' dang 'ja' tshon ltar: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med ro gcig ngang: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan:
phyag 'tshal ba ni:
hūm̐: dus gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: snang stong gnyis med ngang du rab gus pas: rtse gcig dad pa'i blo yis gus btud nas: don dam gnyis med ngang du phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho:
de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul te: phyi thun mong gi mchod pa ni:

hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am 'jig rten gzhan dag na: phyi nang snod bcud dbang po tshim byed pa'i: lha mi'i 'dod yon longs spyod dpag med rnams: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: ā+om̐ sarba pū tsa ma hā sa ma ye hūm̐: hūm̐: lha mo dkar mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ba'i mdangs ldan pa'i: sgeg mo'i phyag na me tog sna tshogs bsnams: bla ma yi dam= ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐: hūm̐: lha mo ser mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can: ga pur tsan+dan rgya shug la sogs pa'i: sgeg mo'i phyag na bdug spos dpag med bsnams: bla ma yi dam= ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐: hūm̐: lha mo dmar mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can: 'bru mar zhun mar snang gsal 'od kyi tshogs: sgeg mo'i phyag na snang gsal dpag med bsnams: bla ma yi dam= ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐: hūm̐: lha mo ljang gu rab mdzes ngang tshul can: tsan+dan gur gum rtsi chen si h+la sogs: sgeg mo'i phyag na dri chab dpag med bsnams: bla ma yi dam= ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐: hūm̐: lha mo dkar mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can: rang byung lhan skyes sbyar ba'i zas la sogs: sgeg mo'i phyag na zhal zas dpag med bsnams: bla ma yi dam= ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra nai wid+ya hūm̐: hūm̐: lha mo sngon mo rab mdzes ngang tshul can: rnga dung dril bu pi waṃ 'byung ba'i sgra: sgeg mo'i phyag na sil snyan dpag med bsnams:
bla ma yi dam= ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra shab+da hūm̐:
de nas nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na: gzugs mchog rab mdzes ji snyed yod pa kun: rdo rje gzugs ma'i tshogs su kun sprul nas: bla ma yi dam= ā+om̐ āḥbadz+ra rū pa hūm̐: hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na: sgra mchog skad snyan ji snyed yod pa kun: rdo rje sgra ma'i tshogs su kun sprul nas: bla ma yi dam= ā+om̐ āḥbadz+ra shab+da hūm̐: hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na: dri mchog bzang po ji snyed yod pa kun: rdo rje dri ma'i tshogs su kun sprul nas: bla ma yi dam= ā+om̐ āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐: hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na: longs spyod ro mchog ji snyed yod pa kun: rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs su kun sprul nas: bla ma yi dam= ā+om̐ āḥbadz+ra ra sa hūm̐: hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na: rab mdzes na bza' ji snyed yod pa kun: rdo rje reg ma'i tshogs su kun sprul nas: bla ma yi dam= ā+om̐ āḥbadz+ra spar+she hūm̐:
de nas gsang mchod rig ma 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐: gsang mchog sku yi bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog dkar mdzes me long pad+ma bsnams: bde ba mchog gis rgyal ba mnyes par mdzad: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ā+om̐ badz+ra ā dar+sha āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: gsang mchog gsung gi bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog dmar mdzes rnga zlum sgra sgrog ma: bde ba mchog gis rgyal ba mnyes par mdzad: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ā+om̐ badz+ra mu rañdze āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: gsang mchog thugs kyi bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog mthing mdzes pi waṃ sgra sgrog ma: bde ba mchog gis rgyal ba mnyes par mdzad: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ā+om̐ badz+ra wī ṇi āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: gsang mchog yon tan bde chen rig ma yin: sku mdog ser mdzes gling bu'i sgra sgrog ma: bde ba mchog gis rgyal ba mnyes par mdzad: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ā+om̐ badz+ra waṃ se āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: gsang mchog phrin las bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog ljang mdzes rdza rnga'i sgra sgrog ma: bde ba mchog gis rgyal ba mnyes par mdzad: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ā+om̐ badz+ra dharme āḥhūm̐:
de nas sman gtor rak+ta'i mchod pa ni:

hūm̐: rang byung rnam dag ye shes sgrub pa'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar a mṛta: bla med ye shes lnga rdzogs sgrub pa'i rdzas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: ā+om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: hūm̐: snod bcud snang srid dam rdzas gtor chen po: 'dod yon rgyan dang longs spyod sprin du gtibs: ro mchog yon tan brgya dang ldan pa 'di: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: ā+om̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: 'khor ba rgyu las bsgral pa'i rak+ta mchog: thabs shes 'khor 'das gnyis su med par bskyil: gzung 'dzin ru tra dbyings su dag bya'i phyir: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: ā+om̐ ma hā rak+ta khā hi:
bstod pa bya ba ni:

hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las byon bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chos sku skye med spros bral ngang nyid las: 'gro don bsgrub phyir zhi khro gtso dang 'khor: thugs rje'i ngang las sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thabs shes bde chen gnyis su med pa las: ma 'gags rang gsal ye shes las grub tshogs: legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i: dam can mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:
bshags pa bya ba ni:

hūm̐: dgongs shig bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rdo rje slob dpon rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: dus gsum bde gshegs bsgrub pa'i dam tshig can: sku gsum gdung sob rdo rje lcam dral mched: dpang gyur skyabs mchog ma lus dgongs su gsol: bdag ni ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis: slob dpon mched sogs sku smad ngan smras shing: yi dam sngags dang phyag rgya gsang ba bsgrags: rtsa ba'i dam las 'gal gyur mthol zhing bshags: shes bya lnga dang spyad par bya ba lnga: mi spang lnga dang bsgrub par bya rgyu lnga: dang len lnga sogs yan lag dam tshig kun: nyams gyur rang gnong 'gyod pas mthol zhing bshags: sngags la the tshom bla med theg pa smad: lta spyod ya bral bsnyen sgrub gzhung ma bsrang: log spyod le los dus kyi mchod pa chag: sdom gsum thun mong dam tshig mthol zhing bshags: rig pa'i rtsal chung snying po'i don ma rtogs: sgom pa'i sran chung gnas lugs so ma thub: blo yi stobs chung spyod pas bogs ma thon: legs bsam spyad kyang don log thugs 'gal gyur: 'bras bu yid smon gyur pa mthol zhing bshags:
zhes bshags shing 'di ni rgyun bshags nar mar yang shin tu zab bo: smon lam btab pa ni:

hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mched la sogs: spyad dang bskul btab yi rangs las byung ba'i: bsod nams dpag med dge tshogs de dag gis: tshe 'dir bla med byang chub 'bras thob nas: sku gsum bde chen zhing du spyod byed cing: gzugs skus 'gro don rlabs chen spyod par shog:
bkra shis brjod pa ni:

hūm̐: dus gsum bla ma sku gsum bdag nyid can: dbyer med rang la rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: thabs shes zung 'jug snang stong yi dam lha: don dam 'du 'bral med pa'i bkra shis shog: 'khor 'das chos la dbang bsgyur mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: phyi nang bar chad zhi ba'i bkra shis shog:

ces brjod: rdzogs rim bsgom: rgyun spyod la 'jug par bya'o: kye ho bdag 'dra gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po yis: yang gsang snying po bla ma'i thugs sgrub las: sgrub chen dbang dang sku gsum sgrub pa dang: rten gsum rab gnas gshin don bdun tshigs sogs: de dag rnams kyi kha skong cha rkyen dang: rnal 'byor sgrub mchod nar mar bya ba'i phyir: gu ru nyid la bka' lung zhus nas kyang: ma 'ongs don du gsal byed yi ger bkod: da lta mi spel gter du sba bar bsam: ma 'ongs rtsod ldan dus kyi snyigs ma la: skal ldan skyes bu gcig dang 'di 'phrad nas: rang gzhan 'gro ba'i don la spyod par shog: bla ma'i sgrub pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod phreng zhes bya ba rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya: ma ning srog bdud bka' 'di ched du srung: dge ri ma yis phyi yi bya ra mdzod: sa ma ya: kha thaṃ: gu h+ya: ྈྈྈྈྈ sa rta lug zla'i tshes brgyad la/ rdzun rkyal rat+na gling pas gnyal smad dge ri'i brag nas gdan drangs pa'o// shog ser ngos las chos rdzong dgon par bshus pa yin//
